subject: Azure Partner Center intake + routing checklist for Contoso (request)
messages:
From: Nick Shaw <nick.shaw@contoso.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso North America)

Hi Jonas / Vanessa / Karthik,

We're ready to kick off an Azure co-sell referral for a set of Contoso accounts (North America pilot). I attached a roster with account names, subscription IDs, and the stakeholders on our side. Primary ask: can Redwood intake these into Partner Center and route to the appropriate field sellers so Microsoft co-sell can engage?

High-level details:
- 12 target accounts, focus on manufacturing and retail workloads
- Procurement and technical contacts included in the roster
- Contoso wants a quick eligibility check for co-sell and clarity on next steps for partner center submission

Can you confirm the information you need (subscription IDs, sales owner mapping, NDA/cert evidence) and an estimated timeline for routing?

Thanks,
Nick
Nick Shaw
Principal Cloud Architect, Contoso
Attachments: Contoso_Azure_account_roster.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Nick Shaw <nick.shaw@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso North America)

Thanks Nick — appreciate the roster. I pulled it down and skimmed the subscription IDs; good starting point. Short reply with a proposed intake checklist and next actions so we can hand this cleanly to Partner Center and the field: 

- Confirm primary Contoso contact per account (name + email) — you have most of them but a few rows are missing primary sales contacts
- Confirm which accounts are currently covered by Microsoft field sellers (we can run a quick mapping)
- Provide any compliance artifacts if Contoso requires them before referral (SOC2 / DPA links are fine)
- Decide whether we want a single referral for all accounts or staged waves (recommended: 3-wave pilot)

If you can return the completed intake form (I attached a quick template) by EOD Tuesday we can kick the eligibility checks and request routing from Microsoft. Vanessa, looping you on the field mapping — can your team propose owner mapping and an initial rollout cadence?

Jonas Weber
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nick Shaw <nick.shaw@contoso.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso North America)

Jonas / team — happy to take point on seller mapping. Quick notes: 

- I ran an initial owner stitch against our field roster and flagged likely owners for 9/12 accounts (attached a filled intake form for those rows).
- Suggest wave 1 = 4 accounts (highest ARR potential), wave 2 = next 4, wave 3 = final 4. That keeps Microsoft engagement focused and measurable.
- For accounts without a clear MS owner, I propose we use regional partner leads and request Partner Center triage to assign a seller so engagement isn't delayed.

Links: intake draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-PartnerIntake
Attachment: PC_intake_form.pdf (fillable PDF)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Contoso confirms missing primary contacts and returns the completed intake PDF
2) We run Partner Center owner validation with Microsoft (Elena, can you advise the fastest route?)
3) Once owner mapping is confirmed, we submit referrals in waves and schedule a 30-min sync with Contoso + MS seller for each wave kickoff

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@microsoft.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nick Shaw <nick.shaw@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso North America)

Thanks Vanessa — happy to help route. Quick operational notes from Partner Center: 

- Best path: submit referrals via Partner Center portal and include subscription IDs + Contoso primary contacts. If Redwood is submitting on behalf of Contoso, please confirm partner tenancy and permissions.
- For accounts that don’t show a current MS seller, we can request a seller assignment but that adds ~3 business days for triage.
- Please include any existing MPN/Partner IDs for Contoso (if they have one) to speed matching.

We also recommend adding the following to the intake to reduce back-and-forth:
- Customer tenant ID
- Estimated ARR / opportunity size per account (ballpark is fine)
- Any required compliance forms (DPA/SCCs) — we can attach to the referral record

I can run the owner validation once you submit the first wave. If you prefer, I can pre-validate the 12 accounts now if you share the missing contact rows and confirm Redwood's partner submission privileges.

Elena Martinez
Partner Center Program Manager, Microsoft
elena.martinez@microsoft.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-17T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso North America) — action plan

Summary and owner assignments:

- Action 1 (Contoso): Nick to return completed PC_intake_form.pdf with missing primary contacts and tenant IDs by EOD 2026-11-19. (Nick)
- Action 2 (Redwood Field): Vanessa to finalize owner mapping for wave 1 and share a 4-account rollout plan by 2026-11-18. (Vanessa)
- Action 3 (Redwood Ops): Karthik to verify Redwood submission permissions in Partner Center and prep referral bundle (attachments + notes) by 2026-11-19. (Karthik)
- Action 4 (Microsoft): Elena to pre-validate owner list on receipt and queue triage for accounts without MS owners (3 business day window). (Elena)

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for next Tuesday to review wave 1 mapping and confirm the referral submission envelope. Tentative: 2026-11-23 09:00 PT — invite forthcoming.

Thanks everyone — this feels like a clean intake. Ping me if anything changes.

Jonas Weber
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
